This should be ruled out before diving into using CBT though sleep hygiene counseling can be started at the same time a sleep study is ordered.
Sleep hygiene counseling for this particular patient can include: increasing physical activity, modulating the sleep environment (turning off light, noise control), and cutting down on alcohol.

There is at first a concern for alcohol use disorder but given that it does not cause dysfunction in this patient’s life, alcohol reduction counseling may be advised as alcohol causes poor quality of sleep.
